definitions.explanation: Loanword from English 'long', most often attached to clothing, hair, or other items to indicate a longer-than-standard version. Also used on its own, especially of hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ロングスカート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
examples.english: Long skirts are in fashion this year.

examples.japanese: ロングコート⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着|き}て→着る：00541_kiru⟧⟦{出|で}かけた→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: I put on a long coat and went out.

notes:
Most often a modifier in compound katakana words, but it also stands alone, especially of hair (⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ロング⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, ロング⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧). The antonym ⟦ショート→ショート：10951_shooto⟧ (short) follows the same pattern.

COMPOUNDS:
- ロングヘア: long hair
- ロングスカート: long skirt
- ロングコート: long coat
- ロングセラー: long-time bestseller
- ロングラン: long run (of a show or film)
